## Public events

**Science Smackdown: The Ultimate Debate**, World Science Festival Brisbane (2025)
: A 90-minute show in the QPAC Concert Hall combining science and comedy to inform and entertain. I debated on Team Wellness Warriors in *"Wellness influencers will outlive us all!"*, hosted by Natasha Mitchell and broadcast on ABC Radio National's *Big Ideas*, 13 August 2025. [Listen on ABC listen](https://www.abc.net.au/listen/programs/bigideas/wellness-influencers-debate-world-science-festival-brisbane/105588530)

**Future Science Talks: Comedy Edition**, Brisbane Comedy Festival (2024)
: A 10-minute science stand-up set, part of an outreach program supported by Inspiring Australia (Queensland).
